content:
Hello everyone!

better.codes is live as of a few hours ago! The ethereum foundation has a short blog announcing it. This was setup with support from Yukon and zkSecurity.

This is an offshoot of the $1m proximity prize aiming to resolve some conjectures in coding theory which have a direct impact on the efficiency of commonly used cryptographic proofs (SNARKs) . See the prize website and reference paper for more details about the conjectures underlying the prize.

better.codes is an attempt at progressing on this problem via autoresearch built on top the formalization of the conjectures (and associated coding theory and cryptography) in ArkLib (see #ArkLib). Anyone can point their human expertise and agents towards this challenge.
We're also hoping to upstream interesting results, including impossibility results, as well as proof techniques and tactics, into ArkLib.

For anyone who hasn't previously heard of these autoresearch based efforts, ecdsa.fail, zk.golf (in Lean, based on clean), and snark.fast, have already shown interesting results in quantum circuit design, verified ZK circuits, and proving speed for SNARKs. We have more challenges planned that will make use of Lean.
